name: auf:method:realized-net-cash-flow@1
summary: Observation profile: realized net cash flow of a Unit over a window, inflow minus outflow through its ports for one asset, or for several assets with declared conversion rates.

observation.description: assertionId or canonical hash of the observation record

algorithm.description: value = inflow - outflow over the observation window, using only transfers that cross a port of the Unit. Internal transfers are excluded by construction. The output is a historical measurement, not a value of the Unit, and must not be presented as one.

assumptions: The observation record satisfies the reconciliation rule of Section 8.2 for the asset.
Missing members of the observation are listed under missing and are not treated as zero.

composability.conditions: Across disjoint Units with disjoint ports and the same asset and window; transfers between the Units become internal transfers of the composite and are removed.
